description: Surface what is blocking you across GitHub, Jira, Linear, and Slack, ranked by severity. Detects blockers from signals, not self-report: explicit 'blocked / waiting on / stuck' language, PRs awaiting review, in-progress tickets that have not moved, and requests for help.

days.description: Look back this many days from now instead of the default window.

since.description: ISO date/time start of the window, e.g. 2026-06-16. Overrides the default. Default covers the last working day (Monday reaches back to Friday).

name: blocker_scan
title: Blocker Scan
